title: Trading Policy

tiers.name: Access Persons
tiers.description: Executive Directors of MFG and Magellan, any employee of Magellan, and contractors, consultants, workers or interns of the Group globally as determined by the CCO. Subject to the full Trading Policy together with Magellan's Personal Trading Policy.

tiers.name: Directors
tiers.description: Directors of MFG and Magellan (executive and non-executive); referenced alongside Access Persons throughout and subject to identical substantive restrictions.

tiers.name: Beneficiaries
tiers.description: Any person who has the opportunity to profit or share in gains from Trades in MFG Securities, including immediate family members sharing the same household for six of any twelve months; relevant to whose accounts an Access Person or Director is deemed to have a beneficial interest in.

definitions.hedging_definition: derivative instruments or other products associated with MFG Securities which operate to limit the economic risk of their holding in MFG Securities

windows.start_anchor: the first Trading Day after the end of a financial reporting period (half-year or full-year)
windows.end_anchor: the first Trading Day after MFG's release of its half-year or full-year results announcement (as applicable)

ad_hoc_blackout_authority: Any other period as the Directors of MFG decide is a Blackout Period; whether such additional periods are kept confidential is not addressed.

rules.detail: Access Persons and Directors are prohibited from entering into transactions in derivative instruments or other products associated with MFG Securities which operate to limit the economic risk of their holding. A narrow exception exists via CCO written consent in special circumstances (financial hardship, court order), never while possessing Inside Information (3.5).
rules.evidence: Access Persons and Directors are prohibited from entering into transactions: in derivative instruments or other products associated with MFG Securities which operate to limit the economic risk of their holding in MFG Securities

rules.detail: Same express prohibition as derivatives; the policy does not distinguish by vesting state, so hedging of vested or unvested MFG Securities is equally banned subject only to the narrow CCO exceptional-circumstances consent.
rules.evidence: in derivative instruments or other products associated with MFG Securities which operate to limit the economic risk of their holding in MFG Securities

rules.detail: A monetisation such as a prepaid forward is not named, but 'Trade' includes entering into an agreement to subscribe for, purchase, acquire, sell or dispose of MFG Securities (which itself includes third-party financial products created over MFG Securities), so it is a Trade requiring pre-clearance under section 4, subject to the Blackout Period and short-term trading rules; a structure that also limits economic risk of the holding would separately breach 3.3.
rules.evidence: 'Trade' includes subscribing for, purchasing, acquiring, selling or disposing of MFG Securities or entering into an agreement to do any of those things

rules.detail: Outright ban on transactions amounting to short selling of MFG Securities, subject only to the narrow CCO exceptional-circumstances consent under 3.5.
rules.evidence: which amount to ‘short selling’ of MFG Securities

rules.detail: Securities lending is not named and is not included in the 'Trade' definition.

CFDs are not named but are 'other products associated with MFG Securities which operate to limit the economic risk of ... holding', so they fall within the same express prohibition as other derivatives.
rules.evidence: in derivative instruments or other products associated with MFG Securities which operate to limit the economic risk of their holding in MFG Securities

rules.detail: Margin lending of MFG Securities is prohibited except in exceptional circumstances acceptable to, and approved by, the MFG Board. Where approved, the person must make a quarterly certification that sufficient cash or other acceptable collateral is available to meet a margin call during a Blackout Period so that a sale of MFG Securities would be prevented.
rules.evidence: Margin lending of MFG Securities by Access Persons or Directors is prohibited except in exceptional circumstances that are acceptable to and have been approved by the MFG Board.

rules.detail: Only 'margin lending' is expressly regulated (3.4); granting security or a charge over MFG Securities outside a margin lending arrangement is not separately addressed.
The policy regulates 'margin lending' by name only; other secured financing arrangements over MFG Securities that are not margin loans are not addressed.

Buying and selling (or selling and buying) MFG Securities within a three month period is prohibited as short-term trading, except for options acquired under the Employee Options Plan, and except selling MFG Securities immediately after acquiring them through conversion of a security (e.g. exercise of an option), subject to pre-clearance.
rules.evidence: Access Persons and Directors must not engage in short-term trading of any MFG Securities (other than options acquired under the Employee Options Plan). Buying and selling (or selling and buying) within a three (3) month period is considered short-term.

clearance.approver: CCO, via Magellan's Personal Trading Policy pre-clearance system
clearance.post_trade_to: Risk and Compliance (via the broker's duplicate Trade confirmation)
clearance.evidence: an Access Person or Director who wishes to Trade in MFG Securities must submit a pre-clearance request and obtain approval (which is provided via email) as per MFG’s Personal Trading Policy. Approvals once granted are valid for one (1) Trading Day unless otherwise notified.

clearance.approver: CCO (and, for margin loans, the MFG Board)
clearance.evidence: may apply in writing to the CCO for consent. The CCO will generally withhold prior written consent unless special circumstances exist (such as financial hardship or a court order requiring the sale of securities) and as required above, will only consent when the MFG Board has granted consent.

short_term.basis: from acquisition (or sale), whichever is first
carve_outs: Options acquired under the Employee Options Plan
Sale of MFG Securities immediately after acquisition through conversion of a security (e.g. exercise of an option), subject to Magellan's Personal Trading Policy pre-clearance requirements
short_term.evidence: Buying and selling (or selling and buying) within a three (3) month period is considered short-term. However, subject to the pre-clearance requirements under Magellan’s Personal Trading Policy, the sale of MFG Securities immediately after they have been acquired through the conversion of a security ... will not be regarded as short-term trading.

exceptions.evidence: an investment in, or trading in any units of, a fund or any scheme (other than a scheme investing only in MFG Securities) where the Access Person or Director is not in the position to influence the Trading activities of that fund or scheme

Trading in MFG Securities under a dividend or distribution reinvestment plan, rights issue, bonus issue (made to all holders of securities of the same class), security purchase plan or other securities offer that is broadly available to holders of securities of the same class (whilst not subject to pre-clearance, updated holdings still require reporting to Risk and Compliance)
any transfers between different accounts of the Access Person or Director where there is no change in the beneficial owner
undertakings to accept, or the acceptance of, a takeover offer for MFG Securities
Trading in MFG Securities under an employee share purchase plan in accordance with the rules of a Board approved share purchase plan

exceptions.approver: CCO (and MFG Board for margin loans)
exceptions.evidence: special circumstances exist (such as financial hardship or a court order requiring the sale of securities)

exceptions.approver: CCO (and MFG Board for margin loans)

financing.price_trigger_guidance: Quarterly certification must confirm that in the event of a margin call during a Blackout Period, sufficient available cash or other acceptable collateral is available to meet any margin calls to provide reasonable assurance that a sale of MFG Securities would be prevented.
financing_disclosure: Access Persons/Directors with an MFG Board-approved margin loan: quarterly certification to the Board/CCO confirming sufficient cash or acceptable collateral is available to meet margin calls during a Blackout Period.

external_documents: Magellan Asset Management Limited's Personal Trading Policy
exemption_authority: The CCO may consent in writing to Trade during a Blackout Period, or to engage in short-term trading or an otherwise prohibited 3.3 transaction, generally only where special circumstances exist (financial hardship or a court order), and for margin lending only once the MFG Board itself has approved; consent is never given where the person may be in possession of Inside Information.

bespoke_clauses.clause: the Access Person or Director is required to make a quarterly certification to confirm that in the event of a margin call during a Blackout Period, sufficient available cash or other acceptable collateral is available to meet any margin calls to provide reasonable assurance that a sale of MFG Securities would be prevented.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: If the collar's financing were treated as a margin loan, the executive would need to certify quarterly that a margin call during a blackout period would not force liquidation, effectively requiring a cash or collateral buffer beyond the collared shares.

bespoke_clauses.clause: 'MFG Securities' means any shares, options and any other securities issued by MFG, as well as any other financial products issued or created over MFG Securities by third parties.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: An OTC put and call written by a bank is itself an 'MFG Security' by this definition, so entering it is a Trade requiring pre-clearance and blackout compliance in its own right, quite apart from the section 3.3 ban on using it to limit economic risk of the shareholding.

bespoke_clauses.clause: with an employee, individual or agent of a broker/dealer with whom the Group conducts business
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: If the bank writing the collar is a broker/dealer with which the Magellan Group conducts business, transacting with its personnel may itself be a separately prohibited counterparty under 3.3.

bespoke_clauses.topic: MFG Board approval gates margin loans
bespoke_clauses.clause: Margin lending of MFG Securities by Access Persons or Directors is prohibited except in exceptional circumstances that are acceptable to and have been approved by the MFG Board.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The loan leg of a funded collar, if treated as margin lending, requires the MFG Board itself (not just the CCO) to approve it as an exceptional circumstance before the CCO can consent to the associated Trade.

summary: A funded collar faces two layered obstacles under this policy. Entering the put and call is expressly prohibited by section 3.3's ban on derivative transactions that limit the economic risk of an MFG Securities holding, and can only proceed with the CCO's written consent, which is generally reserved for financial hardship or a court order and is never given while the person may hold Inside Information. The loan leg, if treated as margin lending, is separately prohibited unless the MFG Board itself approves it as an exceptional circumstance, and even then the executive must certify quarterly that a margin call during a Blackout Period would not force a sale of the shares. Both legs, and any monetisation alternative structured as a Trade, are additionally subject to the standard pre-clearance regime, the Blackout Period (from the first trading day after a reporting period end until the day after results release), and the three-month short-term trading ban. A funded collar is therefore only achievable with dual CCO and MFG Board sign-off, executed outside blackout periods and while the executive holds no Inside Information, rather than as a matter of right.
